name: Resample tck
summary: Resamples the streamlines of a .tck tractogram to a new step size (mm) or a fixed number of points per streamline with DIPY.
description: Loads the tractogram with nibabel and resamples each streamline with dipy set_number_of_points, either to floor(length/step) points for a given step size or to a fixed number of points, and saves a new .tck. Use it to harmonise streamline sampling before segmentation or comparison methods that expect a given step size or point count.

parameters.description: Resampling can be done either by setting the new step size (in mm) or the new number of points. Tell which option you want to use.

options.label: I want to set the new step size
I want to set the new number of points

parameters.description: Set the step size OR the number of points, depending on your choice above
